scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
an extrusion in the MCAD Software has Feature Appearance set to As Body
the user opens Feature Properties from its browser context menu
the user opens the Feature Appearance list
the list offers As Body and named appearances including Black
the user clicks Cancel and reopens Feature Properties
the dialog closes and the solid remains visible
